phases.title: Freeze Graph Authority Envelope And Runtime Identity Law
acceptance: UiGraphSnapshot exists as the one committed graph authority artifact and committed snapshots are immutable
UiGraphNodeIdentity stays distinct from UiDeclarationIdentity and never depends on tree position
repeated-instance identity basis is explicit, typed, and denies basis-free or position-based runtime identity
graph authority carries explicit generation and world basis posture so same-world mutation and cross-world re-admission remain distinguishable
phases.instructions: Freeze the graph authority envelope first. Make snapshot lifecycle, graph identity, repeated-instance basis, generation, and world basis explicit before topology or participation work broadens the surface.
phases.qa_focus: No tree-position identity, no mutable committed snapshot, no implicit repeated-instance basis, and no ambient world classification.

phases.title: Admit Graph Nodes Only Through The Sealed 3.2 Handoff Boundary
acceptance: only sealed UiDeclarationGraphHandoff inputs can instantiate graph truth
graph instantiation decides nodes, topology, participation posture, attachment posture, mounted-receipt authority seeds, and core index contributions only
graph instantiation does not absorb graph-touch obligations, Query support/admission, service admission, measurement admission, or intent operability
runtime-data-keyed repeated-instance basis enters through an admitted typed boundary or denies locally
phases.instructions: Keep this boundary narrow and named honestly. Implement graph instantiation from sealed 3.2 handoff and deny contradictory or basis-free inputs before graph mutation begins.
phases.qa_focus: No source reopening, no parser-local graph construction, no 3.4 admission bleed, and no caller-local instance keys.

phases.title: Materialize Parent Child Slot And Membership Topology As Graph Truth
acceptance: parent-child-slot topology becomes graph-owned runtime truth, not declaration leftovers
page, region, and mosaic membership are explicit graph facts with bounded lookup surfaces
graph-owned attachment posture has one authoritative home in graph truth rather than future side registries
topology indexes land with topology truth instead of temporary traversal-based access
phases.instructions: Turn structural intent into runtime topology and explicit memberships. Make topology index-backed as it lands so later phases never normalize temporary recursive-walk access.
phases.qa_focus: No implicit sibling-order slots, no generic membership tags, no side topology for attachments, and no temporary walk-based ordinary lookup.

phases.title: Encode Participation As Explicit Multi Axis Runtime Posture
acceptance: participation axes remain explicit: exists, mounted, visible, layout, hit-test, focus, accessibility, paint, input, query-bound, service-bound, and diagnostic
each participation posture carries status, source/reason classification, and evidence reference or equivalent handle
page participation lookup returns enough structure to explain axis-specific inclusion without descendant walks
participation index surfaces land with participation truth rather than after a temporary boolean or containment-based phase
phases.instructions: Make participation explicit and explainable, not just stored. The runtime must know both what participates and why without inferring posture from host or renderer residue.
phases.qa_focus: No one-boolean participation collapse, no hidden source for disabled axes, no containment-only page participation, and no unexplained false posture.

phases.title: Seed Mounted Receipt Authority At The Graph Boundary
acceptance: mounted receipt identity, graph correspondence, mounted posture relationship, and authority seed storage are graph-owned
mounted receipt authority seeds are indexable and correspond explicitly to graph nodes
phase 5 does not produce mounted frame receipts, paint intent, allocation boxes, visual geometry, layout-derived boxes, or host adapter output
mounted receipt authority seed lookup lands with the seed lane instead of later side storage
phases.instructions: Keep mounted receipts narrow here. This phase seeds graph-owned mounted evidence slots only and must not accidentally pull in the later mounting runtime.
phases.qa_focus: No host-local mounted store, no mounted-frame creep, no authority seed without graph correspondence, and no fake mounting semantics.

phases.title: Build The Core Index Set And Make Ordinary Lookup Bounded
acceptance: the mandatory core index set exists for node identity, declaration correspondence, topology, page participation, aspect publishers/consumers, and mounted receipt slots
lookup receipts make cost class and index family explicit enough to prove no silent traversal occurred
aspect indexes are many-to-many and classify publisher/consumer kinds without future side maps
phase 6 closes the full index set, cost-honesty contract, and residue proof while earlier phases already landed the indexes their truth lanes needed
phases.instructions: Close the index set as proof, not as a late optimization. Make ordinary graph lookup bounded, typed, receipt-backed, and aspect-aware.
phases.qa_focus: No hidden recursive walks, no untyped aspect maps, no index-free ordinary lookup, and no phase-local temporary traversal APIs left behind.

phases.title: Transactionally Align Graph Mutation And Index Mutation
acceptance: all graph mutation occurs through admitted graph mutation plans and the closed initial mutation vocabulary
committed graph snapshots and committed index state always move together as one coherent generation transition
public graph authority exposes either the prior coherent snapshot or the new coherent snapshot, never a half-committed or repair-required state
direct node-map, index, membership, or mounted-receipt authority-seed mutation outside the mutation boundary is mechanically rejected
phases.instructions: Turn transaction language into an operational boundary. Close the mutation vocabulary, make generation-based commit explicit, and ban every ordinary bypass path.
phases.qa_focus: No best-effort coherence, no direct index surgery, no partial publish, and no decorative transaction wrapper over mutable side stores.

phases.title: Close Graph Authority And Hand 3.4 A Proof Bearing Runtime Surface
acceptance: 3.4 consumes graph-owned identity, correspondence, topology, participation, attachment posture, aspect indexes, and mounted receipt authority seeds through proof-bearing graph surfaces
graph truth is inspectable through the formal inspection architecture with thin targetability, evidence refs, and graph-relevant stop points
closeout enumerates the exact identity, topology, participation, attachment, mounted receipt, index, and graph-inspection support lanes 3.3 closes
the milestone rejects raw graph internals, recursive tree walks, and side topologies as ordinary public graph-access surfaces
phases.instructions: Close the milestone with proof instead of ceremony. Make the 3.4 handoff exact, keep graph inspection thin, and preserve the truth that Query-owned and later runtime lanes remain outside 3.3.
phases.qa_focus: Honest closeout, exact 3.4 handoff, no overclaiming Query/service/measurement runtime behavior, and no ambiguous graph boundary residue.
